title: kbmon's delivery alert has an empty or moving since: distill.log's last write, not the refusal's start
goal: the delivery alert's since is the time the refusal began (the query log's undelivered_since or the refused run's own time) and stays the same while later lines are written

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
H=tempfile.mkdtemp();E=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=H,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd(),NO_COLOR='1')
q=os.path.join(H,'querylog');os.makedirs(q,exist_ok=True)
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_deliver
say=ql_deliver.logged(q,out=lambda t:None)
def k(*a): return s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=120)
say('apply --push: refused: planted');say('distill: nothing to write')
a=json.loads(k('--json','--panel','querylog').stdout).get('alerts',[])
print(a);sys.exit(0 if a and a[0].get('since') else 1)
